title: Diagnostic logs
description: Events are grouped by cause without deleting the original logs. Event counts are not solver failure rates or affected-user counts. Consult records and archives for historical events.
loadFailed: Could not read diagnostic logs. Please try again later.
unconfigured: Persistent diagnostics storage is not configured. An empty list does not mean there are no errors.
truncated: The read limit was reached; this is a partial result. Original logs are retained. Select a shorter period or inspect the server archive.
empty: No matching diagnostic events in this period. Collection starts when this feature is deployed.
recentHint: Shows up to the latest one hundred entries in this period, then filters by category. Earlier entries remain in server logs. Sensitive content is redacted.
